test_title: PYST 11: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence that does NOT have a spelling error.

options.text: Meet me in my office tomorow.
Meet me in my office tomorrow.
Meet me in my office tommorow.
Meet me in my office tommorrow.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Sentence 1 has a spelling error: "tomorow" should be "tomorrow".
 
• Sentence 2 is correct: "tomorrow" is spelled correctly.
 
• Sentence 3 has a spelling error: "tommorow" should be "tomorrow".
 
• Sentence 4 has a spelling error: "tommorrow" should be "tomorrow".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
